chosen_titles.rationale: Title 24 (Government - State) contains the Colorado Sunshine Law at Article 6, including Part 3 (Regulation of Lobbyists) which is the lobbying-disclosure regime (C.R.S. §§24-6-301 to 24-6-309).

notes: Vintage 2010 not on Justia. Tried 2010, 2011, 2009, 2012, 2008 - all return 'Page not found'. The Justia all-versions page for Colorado (https://law.justia.com/codes/colorado/) lists 2016 as the earliest available vintage. Substituted to 2016 (6 years off, outside the typical ±5 window, but the only available option). Same substitution pattern as CO_2015 bundle (which also substituted to 2016).
